title: 5D position (fingerprint)
description: The ONE fingerprint of an entry — five values summing to 1 (rounded to 6 decimal places), or all-zero when nothing contributes (spec/SPEC.md §5). 5D is neutral on is/ought (§7, N1 — owner design change, 2026-10-01): there is exactly one fingerprint per entry, full stop; an earlier two-fingerprint (is/ought) design on this branch is superseded — see docs/decisions/0003-is-ought-in-nd-grammars.md. This $id resolves once the repository is published; until then, resolve schema $refs from a local copy (see tests/test_conformance.py).
